GET /api/regulatory-sources.description: Host and institution scoped. Server-persisted retrieval evidence is distinct from applicability approval and does not certify legal signatures.

POST /api/regulatory-sources.description: Host and institution scoped. Server-persisted retrieval evidence is distinct from applicability approval and does not certify legal signatures.

POST /api/regulatory-sources/{sourceID}/.description: Host and institution scoped. Server-persisted retrieval evidence is distinct from applicability approval and does not certify legal signatures.
Host and institution scoped. Server-persisted retrieval evidence is distinct from applicability approval and does not certify legal signatures.

GET /api/regulatory-sources/{sourceID}/e.description: Host and institution scoped. Server-persisted retrieval evidence is distinct from applicability approval and does not certify legal signatures.

GET /api/earchiva/retention-rules.description: Host-scoped administrative list with server filtering, sorting and pagination. An internal approval is not external archival certification. Rules are not yet an assertion that a stored document has WORM protection.

POST /api/earchiva/retention-rules.description: Administrative proposal bound to an active series and source, with immutable provenance and explicit retention anchor. Ordinary document uploads cannot set their own legal retention. Unsupported anchors or duration models are rejected rather than substituted.

POST /api/earchiva/retention-rules/{rule.summary: Approve a proposed archive-series retention rule
POST /api/earchiva/retention-rules/{rule.description: Requires a distinct authorized approver and matching version. Activation rejects overlapping active periods for the same series. Existing stored-document retention snapshots are not shortened.
Records the actor and mandatory reason under optimistic concurrency. Retirement stops future use without deleting provenance or shortening existing document retention.

POST /api/admissions/legal-preparations/.summary: Upload the signed PDF bound to a legal preparation artifact
POST /api/admissions/legal-preparations/.description: Accepts only a PDF file. Tenant, institution, actor, retention and object identity are server-derived. Requires archive management and the preparation-specific admission permission. The durable intent precedes the immutable write; retries with the same Idempotency-Key and fingerprint recover the exact object without deletion. Changed content conflicts. Adoption queues OCR; finalization remains blocked until readiness and signature verification.

GET /api/admissions/legal-preparations/{.summary: Read the artifact bound to a legal preparation
GET /api/admissions/legal-preparations/{.description: Returns the scoped, committed archive artifact and its ingestion readiness. Requires archive management and the preparation-specific admission permission. No arbitrary tenant archive version can substitute for this binding.

GET /api/institution/regulatory-profile.summary: Read the active institution regulatory profile
GET /api/institution/regulatory-profile.description: Returns the effective, host-derived institution classification. Tenant and institution fields are response-only provenance.

PUT /api/institution/regulatory-profile.summary: Create the next institution regulatory profile version
PUT /api/institution/regulatory-profile.description: Creates a scope-bound profile version using optimistic concurrency, approves the baseline policy assignments server-side and never accepts tenant or institution identifiers from the client.

GET /api/institution/capabilities.summary: Evaluate effective institution capabilities for the current session
GET /api/institution/capabilities.description: Returns only the server-derived intersection of active modules, live RBAC, the approved institution profile and effective policy packs; raw policy rules are not exposed.

GET /api/institution/policy-cutover-pref.summary: Inspect the institution policy v2 cutover preflight
GET /api/institution/policy-cutover-pref.description: Returns scope-bound aggregate gaps for the legacy-to-v2 policy migration. A structurally ready response is informational and never authorizes a runtime phase transition.

GET /api/institution/locations.description: Returns only locations from the host- and session-bound institution with server-side filtering, sorting and pagination.

POST /api/institution/locations.description: Creates a scope-bound, effective-dated location using a replay-safe idempotency key. Tenant, institution and actor are derived by the server.

PATCH /api/institution/locations/{locati.description: Updates mutable location metadata under optimistic concurrency. Code and effective-from remain immutable. Deactivation requires an explicit effective end and returns 409 if the new window would invalidate a dependent authorization.

GET /api/institution/education-offerings.description: Returns the effective-dated education offerings of the authenticated institution with server-side filtering, sorting and pagination.

POST /api/institution/education-offering.description: Creates a scope-bound, effective-dated offering. A program or level is not considered authorized until a separate authorization decision exists.

PATCH /api/institution/education-offerin.description: Updates mutable offering metadata under optimistic concurrency. The level, specialization, language and effective-from identity fields are never rewritten. Deactivation requires an explicit effective end and returns 409 if the new window would invalidate a dependent authorization.

GET /api/institution/offering-authorizat.description: Returns authorization, accreditation, suspension and withdrawal decisions per offering and physical location. Historical decisions remain separate records.

POST /api/institution/offering-authoriza.description: Creates an initial decision or prospectively replaces a prior decision using optimistic concurrency, verified legal provenance and a replay-safe idempotency key. New positive decisions use provisional or accredited status with an explicit capacity unit and shift; the ambiguous legacy value authorized is read-only until classified from its source act.

GET /api/education/governance/eligible-u.summary: List active tenant users eligible for governance identities
GET /api/education/governance/eligible-u.description: Returns only immutable user IDs and display names for active users in the current tenant. The IDs are required for chair, secretary and governance membership assignment; display names are presentation-only.

POST /api/oidc/session/logout.description: Revokes the tenant-bound refresh grant carried by the HttpOnly refresh cookie and expires that cookie. The route lives below `/api/oidc` so the browser sends the path-scoped cookie.

GET /api/oidc/ui/login.js.description: Public JavaScript served only to the provider-owned login interaction. It supports OTP input focus movement and paste handling; it is not an API payload.

GET /api/oidc/ui/logout.js.description: Public JavaScript served only to the provider-owned logout interaction. It is not an API payload and must not contain tenant secrets or token material.

GET /api/registratura/documents.description: Searches documents visible in the active tenant and registry context. `pageSize`, `sort` and `direction` take precedence when supplied with the Costesti-compatible aliases `limit`, `sortBy` and `sortDir`. All filters use the `filter.<field>` form.

POST /api/registratura/documents.description: Creates an incoming, outgoing or internal registration number in the selected registry. The number is allocated transactionally by the server; clients must never generate it.

POST /api/registratura/documents/batch.description: Creates a batch of documents using the same tenant and authorization rules as single registration. Each item is independently validated and the response identifies accepted and rejected items.

GET /api/registratura/registre.summary: List registries available to the user
GET /api/registratura/registre.description: Returns registries assigned to the current user in the active tenant, including the default registry when configured.

POST /api/registratura/documents/{docume.description: Applies an allowed workflow transition to a document. The server validates state, allowed assignees and permissions before recording history.

GET /api/registratura/flux/queue.description: Costesti-compatible tenant-scoped queue: documents assigned to the caller and unclaimed documents in the caller's departments. Supports server pagination, filtering and sorting.

GET /api/registratura/flux/mapa.description: Costesti-compatible Mapa projection for the active tenant. The server applies all filters, sorting and pagination.

GET /api/registratura/flux/pipeline.summary: List the tenant document workflow pipeline
GET /api/registratura/flux/pipeline.description: Server-paginated, filterable and sortable Costesti pipeline read model.

GET /api/workflow/tasks.description: Returns tasks visible to the active tenant and caller. Filter options are provided by `/api/workflow/tasks/filters`.

POST /api/workflow/tasks/{taskID}/transi.description: Executes a permitted task transition. The server enforces current state and authorization, then writes immutable workflow history.

GET /api/earchiva/records.description: Lists records in the active tenant. This endpoint is separate from binary archive document retrieval and may be filtered or paginated by the implementation.

POST /api/earchiva/records.description: Creates a tenant-scoped archival record. Retention and classification are validated by the server.

GET /api/earchiva/documents.description: Searches documents in the institution context validated from the authenticated token/session and request host. The browser cannot select another institution with a request header.

GET /api/me.description: The frontend uses this endpoint as the source of truth for the current identity, tenant context and effective permissions. Do not trust browser-stored roles.

PUT /api/profile.description: Updates only fields editable by the authenticated user. Administrative identity and tenant role changes use administrative endpoints.

POST /api/registratura/documents/{docume.summary: Upload and malware-scan a document attachment
POST /api/registratura/documents/{docume.description: Accepts one multipart file up to 100 MiB and an optional category. The server streams to bounded temporary storage, scans through clamd, writes object storage, then returns metadata only after the attachment is clean and ready.
This compatibility route is intentionally fail-closed because no binary upload can be bound to a staged row. Clients must use the scanned multipart upload endpoint instead.

GET /api/registratura/documents/{documen.description: Streams a ready, clean attachment after tenant, document and registry visibility checks.

GET /api/registratura/documents/{documen.summary: Print one registry document as PDF

POST /api/registratura/documents/export-.summary: Export a bounded registry date interval as PDF

POST /api/earchiva/documents.description: Accepts a bounded multipart PDF. The active tenant is derived from the authenticated session; the client cannot select an institution. The server validates the PDF, malware-scans it, stores the original and queues OCR/indexing.

GET /api/earchiva/admin/health.description: Returns tenant-scoped operational health and queue counts without exposing credentials, bucket names or object keys.

GET /api/earchiva/documents/{documentID}.description: Streams the original PDF only after tenant, document and archive-content permission checks. Storage bucket and object keys are never returned as JSON.

GET /api/earchiva/admin/stats.description: Returns document and ingestion-job counts for the active tenant only.

GET /api/earchiva/admin/jobs.description: Lists ingestion jobs for the active tenant. Failed-job details are reduced to safe categories and never expose OCR or storage error payloads.

POST /api/earchiva/admin/jobs/{jobID}/re.summary: Retry a failed eArhiva ingestion job
POST /api/earchiva/admin/jobs/{jobID}/re.description: Requeues a failed ingestion job after verifying that it belongs to the active tenant. Cross-tenant and non-failed job identifiers return not found.

GET /api/earchiva/classification-reviews.description: Lists human-review tasks generated from OCR for the active institution only. Suggestions are explainable and never become final metadata without an explicit review decision.

POST /api/earchiva/classification-review.description: Approves the stored suggestion using optimistic revision control. The caller cannot replace classification fields through this operation.
Stores a reviewed, closed classification DTO using optimistic revision control; unknown fields and cross-tenant identifiers are rejected.

POST /api/education/portfolios/me/{recor.summary: Upload a PDF for the authenticated teacher's portfolio
POST /api/education/portfolios/me/{recor.description: Owner-scoped upload into an editable portfolio. The server derives tenant, institution and owner, scans the PDF and atomically persists archive provenance and owner attachment access. Queued uploads cannot be attached until processing succeeds. An idempotent replay returns the same document; changed content under the same key is rejected.

GET /api/school-operations/suppliers.description: Returns active legal/institution parties from the shared tenant party registry for contract selection.

GET /api/school-operations/contracts.description: Server-side filtered, sorted and paginated contract index. Tenant and institution scope come solely from the authenticated host-bound session.

POST /api/school-operations/contracts.description: Creates exactly one tenant-scoped draft contract for an idempotency key. Policy evaluation, tenant and institution are server-derived and immutable provenance.

GET /api/school-operations/contracts/{co.description: Returns one contract only when it belongs to the host-selected tenant and authenticated institution.

PATCH /api/school-operations/contracts/{.description: Uses expected_version optimistic concurrency and records immutable policy, audit and outbox evidence in the same transaction.

GET /api/school-operations/contracts/{co.description: Server-side filtered, sorted and paginated obligation list for one institution-scoped contract.

POST /api/school-operations/contracts/{c.description: Creates an institution-scoped obligation and its policy, audit and outbox evidence atomically.
Applies only valid draft-to-archive lifecycle transitions with expected_version optimistic concurrency; final legal records cannot be deleted.

GET /api/earchiva/admin/portfolio-custod.description: Lists only tenant- and institution-scoped stored intents and durable recovery history. Storage locations, immutable version identifiers, ETags, object metadata and raw worker errors are never exposed.

POST /api/earchiva/admin/portfolio-custo.description: Queues durable adoption of the exact held WORM version after database authorization and server-side fingerprint verification. HTTP 202 means queued, not committed. The operation never reduces retention, disables legal hold, deletes or overwrites storage.

GET /api/earchiva/admin/portfolio-custod.description: Returns the tenant- and institution-scoped durable status using safe error codes only. A committed status is the sole success signal.
